title: The Copycat Winner Notice
intro: You entered a real giveaway on Zelvora's official account. Winners will be announced soon.
Then a DM arrives from "the Zelvora team": you won!

notify.text: You won 5,000 ZLX! One step to claim…

banner.text: New message request · you do not follow this account

screen.context: You liked the real giveaway post yesterday. Winners are announced on the official account.

handle.label: Look-alike handle
handle.lens: @zelvora_g1veaways uses a number 1 instead of an i.
handle.why: Copycat accounts change one character. Check the handle letter by letter.

fee.label: Pay to claim
fee.lens: You are asked to send coins to receive a prize.
fee.why: Real prizes never charge you to receive them.

dm.label: They messaged first
dm.lens: Winners are announced on the official account, not by DM from a new account.
dm.why: Copycats message people who entered real giveaways.

addr.label: Send to a stranger
addr.lens: A raw wallet address belonging to the scammer.
addr.why: Coins sent there cannot be recovered.

timer.label: Redrawn soon
timer.why: Pressure stops you from checking the official post.

winner.label: A big prize
winner.why: A big prize is the bait, not proof.

name.label: Name and tick
name.why: A tick you can type is not a real badge.

avatar.label: Gift logo
avatar.lens: A copy of the giveaway picture.

actions.label: Check the official Zelvora account for the winners list

trap.title: Claim 5,000 ZLX
trap.ask: Send 40 ZLX to 0x7c4…e91 to release your prize.

block_report.line: Blocked and reported. The copycat was removed before it reached other entrants.

verify.line: The official account listed other winners and warned of fake DMs. Case cracked.
verify.mirageSays: Hmph. They read the real post.

ignore.line: You ignored it safely. Reporting protects other entrants.

go_ahead.line: The 40 ZLX went to the scammer. The prize never existed.

what_if.go_ahead: The official post said winners are never asked to pay. That line was the whole answer.
what_if.verify: Checking was smart. Reporting the copycat helps others.
what_if.ignore: Ignoring it was safe. A quick report protects others.

golden_rule: A real prize never costs you anything to claim. Check winners on the official account only.

quick_check.q: After you enter a giveaway, a similar-looking account says you won and asks for a small fee. What do you do?

options.text: Do not pay. Check the official account and report the copycat
Ask for a bigger prize first

quick_check.explain: Prizes are never paid for. Copycats lurk under real giveaways.

hints.nudge: Read the handle one character at a time.
